WEATHER WARS IN 30 SECONDS

Every turn has three simple segments.

Follow the on-screen prompt from left to right. The game highlights every move you can make.

⌖
SEGMENT 1

Claim a region

Click one glowing open tile. Matching neighboring terrain earns a production bonus.

▦
SEGMENT 2

Build your economy

Choose a building card, then place it on one of your regions. Better terrain means more income.

☀
SEGMENT 3

Deliver the forecast

Use helpful weather on your tiles or severe weather on the rival. Finish turn ten with more credits.
